name: python-ty-ruff-pin-policy
body: The ty/ruff dependency pin is a git-dependency pin to a release tag of astral-sh/ruff (the reference used 0.16.6), the same vendored-pin pattern src/rustlib uses for rust-analyzer. It is bumped ATOMICALLY: every ty/ruff crate (ruff_db, ruff_python_ast, ruff_python_parser, ruff_source_file, ruff_text_size, ty_ide, ty_project, ty_python_core, ty_python_semantic, ty_module_resolver, ty_vendored, salsa) moves to the new tag together and the lockfile is re-pinned in the same change — never a partial bump that mixes API versions of the crates. The exact tag number is confirmed at implementation time (validated against current main's needs); the atomic-bump policy is the durable law, the tag literal is not.
